objective: Independent multi-action remote dispatch and result feedback for AI Commerce engineering; multiple Human/Brain actions submitted together with real bounded parallel EF01 execution.
scope_in: Multiple actions per batch and simultaneous admission
Per-action manual Codex/Antigravity model and effort
At least two independent actions truly overlapping in Windows EF01 subprocesses
Per-attempt source SHA, distributed claim, worktree, candidate Git ref
Per-action and aggregate feedback, diagnostics, repair lineage and honest failure/unknown
scope_out: Automatic proactive ChatGPT wake or native continuation without separate live evidence

implementation_cuts.title: Windows concurrent scheduler and EF01 execution

execution_policy.batch_acceptance: multiple; actual ready actions bound by machine/provider availability
execution_policy.retry: no blind retry after executor invocation; new repair attempt

acceptance: Human/Brain can submit multiple actions in a single batch; concurrent batch submissions are durably admitted or explicitly rejected.
A 5-action batch with at least two independent READY actions completes with two overlapping Windows executor subprocesses (not only queued) and traces worktrees and action-specific evidence.
DAG dependency failure blocks only dependents; independent siblings continue and aggregate status is truthful.
At least two distinct selected executor profiles retain exact model and effort; provider quota and unsupported model are explicit failed attempts.
Concurrent duplicate attempts result in one distributed claim winner and no second provider invocation.
Verified scoped candidate refs and full diagnostic artifacts are accessible through GitHub; Brain can read feedback without user manually collecting local logs.
Crash, offline, canceled, source stale and publication failure are not reported as PASS and never blind-invoke provider twice.
No AIOS inherited runtime, no automatic main merge, and no false claim of native Chat Wake.
